summary: Plan workforce adoption for enterprise AI change using readiness, workflow, and adoption measures. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Enterprise change management for AI helps transformation leaders, change managers and AI programme teams plan workforce adoption across workflows. Participants assess role impacts and readiness, map stakeholders and human-oversight responsibilities, and develop role-based communication plans, adoption measures and an integrated change roadmap for coordinating enterprise transformation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate the people, process, and governance changes that accompany enterprise AI adoption. It suits cross-functional teams responsible for moving beyond pilot launches to managed changes in roles, workflows, decision rights, and adoption reporting.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
prerequisites: Intermediate-level experience in a change, transformation, programme, HR, operations, or AI-related role is expected. Familiarity with project or programme delivery and workplace digital change will help you apply the exercises. No coding or AI model development is required; advanced AI governance concepts are introduced at an operational and conceptual level.
